scope: Proposition 4.3 (Dual identity) of the manuscript “Triangular minimality for planar Coulomb renormalized energy” (preprints/Triangular-minimality-for-planar-Coulomb-renormalized-energy-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 090 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6f640e977aed5d3b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For compatible periodic Voronoi data on T = R2/Γ with N ≥ 1 distinct sites, lower edge distance d0 > 0, and |T| = N, let h be the mean-zero potential (4.7). Let I be finite or countable, let ki ≥ 6 be integers with repetitions permitted, and let B, Di ∈ C1((0, ∞)) satisfy (4.3)–(4.4). Let H be the function supplied by Lemma 4.2. Then WT(h) = ∑︂ S J(S) + 1 2 ∫︂ T |∇(h − H)|2 dx ≥ ∑︂ S J(S). (4.11) The sum runs over all face–edge incidences in one torus. No incidence bound or square-torus separation hypothesis is imposed.
